_about: NIPUN Bharat Lakshyas (targets) for Class I-III, from nipun_guidelines PDF pp.200-201 (printed pp.198-199). Wording lightly cleaned of extraction typos.

oral_language: Converses with friends and class teacher about her needs, surroundings.
Talks about the print available in the classroom.
reading: Participates during read aloud/story telling session in an active way and answers questions during and after story session; acts out familiar story with props and puppets.
Uses sound symbol correspondence to write words with invented spellings.
Reads small sentences consisting of at least 4-5 simple words in an age appropriate unknown text.
writing: Develops familiarity with matras in the words occurring in familiar contexts (story/poems/environment print etc.).
Writes, draws and/or makes things to convey meaning; draws pictures that are recognizable objects/people.
numeracy: Counts objects up to 20.
Reads and writes numbers up to 99.
Uses addition and subtraction of numbers up to 9 in daily life situations.
Observes and describes physical properties of 3D shapes around him/her.
Estimates and verifies length using non-standard units like hand span, footstep; capacity using cup, spoon, mug.
Creates and recites short poems and stories using shapes and numbers.

oral_language: Converses and talks about the print available in the classroom.
Engages in conversation to ask questions and listens to others.
Repeats familiar words occurring in stories/poems/print etc.
reading: Reads and narrates/re-tells the stories from children's literature/textbook.
Makes new words from the letters of a given word.
Reads age appropriate unknown text of 8-10 sentences with simple words at approximately 45 to 60 words per minute correctly, with comprehension and clarity.
writing: Writes short/simple sentences correctly to express herself.
Recognizes naming words, action words and punctuation marks.
numeracy: Reads and writes numbers up to 999.
Uses addition and subtraction of numbers up to 99 (sum not exceeding 99) in daily life situations.
Performs multiplication as repeated addition and division as equal sharing; constructs tables of 2, 3 and 4.
Estimates and measures length/distance/capacity using non-standard uniform units and compares weight using a simple balance.
Identifies and describes 2-D shapes like rectangle, triangle, circle, oval.
Uses spatial vocabulary like far/near, in/out, above/below, left/right, front/behind, top/bottom.
Creates and solves simple riddles using numbers and shapes.

oral_language: Converses with clarity using suitable vocabulary in home/school language.
Talks about the print available in the classroom.
Engages in conversation to ask questions, narrate experiences, listen to others and respond.
Recites poems individually and in group with intonation and modulation of voice.
reading: Reads at least 60 words per minute correctly and with comprehension from an age appropriate unknown text.
Reads and follows instructions given in the text.
Can answer at least 3 out of 4 questions based on reading an age appropriate unknown story/paragraph of 8-10 sentences.
writing: Writes short messages for different purposes.
Uses action words, naming words and punctuation marks for writing.
Writes short paragraphs and short stories on her/his own.
numeracy: Reads and writes numbers up to 9999.
Solves daily life problems using addition and subtraction of numbers up to 999.
Constructs and uses multiplication tables of 2 to 10 and uses division facts.
Estimates and measures length, weight and capacity using standard units (m, km, g, kg, litres).
Identifies and relates basic 2D shapes with 3D shapes and describes their properties.
Reads a calendar date and day; reads time on a clock in hours and half-hours.
Identifies half, one-fourth, three-fourth of a whole and of a collection of objects.
Identifies, extends and communicates rules for simple patterns on numbers, events and shapes.
